data.description:
The launch epic — a container task (depends_on its children), created at the 2026-08-07 launch-epic structuring grill (Brandon). Done-ness is DECLARED BY BRANDON, never computed: "tuhdoo is launched" is a judgment call, same pattern as the v1 milestone. Agents must not work this task — if you are an agent holding this claim, release it with reason "human-declared launch epic".

Initial children:
- Grill: site stack & content strategy (human-led) — the decision gate; the three content builds depend on it.
- Marketing/docs site (tuh-01KYX4Y0GZCJTQFNGPP6WMHDM2) — monorepo site/ build.
- User-facing docs (tuh-01KZ9YD2Q9V7BSZJBDGVNYM6QY) — the human story of steering tuhdoo.
- Workflow recipes (tuh-01KYX3KJYP7Y178GH5DJ6JPMRQ) — recommended outer-workflow patterns for adopters.
- Ship the agent protocol with the binary (tuh-01KZANB3J4YYH09F0Z6FSZQ5CD) — the one child claimable today; no grill dependency.

The child set is EXPECTED TO GROW: the strategy grill surfaces launch-execution work (domain purchase, announcement moment, launch checklist) and adds it here as new children with real content — no placeholder children were pre-created. When adding a child, add the edge to this task's depends_on.

Scope notes from the structuring grill: distribution is already solved (npm launcher, release binaries v0.2.0, go install, source — see README Install) and is not a child. The codebase-design-doc capture (tuh-01KZ9Z6647C3TBCYGGTXQJYE8V) is deliberately NOT a child — its audience is Brandon, not adopters. The monorepo-grain question (tuh-01KZA0VT234XJYVZWT8YFV8XE2, held) observes the site/ work but is not launch material.
data.title: Launch tuhdoo: public-facing materials and adoption surface
